result_scope: between these capture periods; not causal attribution
reasons: Baseline ready. Run check with --change none and the same deployment declaration for an unchanged control, or change serving state yourself and select the changed declaration field; TheGrill does not change the server.
assumptions: Model-based interval assumes stable, independent acquisition-level variation and an adequate log-scale mean model. Resetting a client does not prove independence. Positive autocorrelation can make the interval narrower than justified, increasing false directional conclusions. Sequential captures cannot remove time or carryover confounding; no causal attribution, equivalence, noninferiority, or guaranteed precision/power is established.
scope: One short synthetic structured C1/exact400 workload; not general concurrency, long-context, model quality, tail SLOs, or full serving qualification. Deployment values are operator declarations, not server attestation. A settings fingerprint cannot prove only one internal knob changed.
